derivation_notes: The parent treated all confinement-limited microconfigurations as recovering accessibility through one homogeneous mixedness channel. Here the coefficient of that existing accessibility process is allowed to depend on mixedness itself, representing a more strongly blocked subset that unlocks only in nearly balanced local neighborhoods while preserving species-exchange symmetry and the entropy maximum at x = 1/2.
change_summary: A homogeneous single-phase confinement-relief law was refined into heterogeneous confinement relief by making the accessibility coefficient mixedness-dependent. This preserves the same inputs and symmetry but yields flatter intermediate-composition recovery and a sharper near-equimolar rise under appreciable confinement.

assumption_audit.released_assumption: The process already present—composition-assisted recovery of accessible local arrangements under confinement—is represented by one uniform smooth composition dependence for all restricted microconfigurations.
assumption_audit.mechanism: Heterogeneous confinement relief: different subsets of local configurational states require different degrees of local species balance, producing a two-stage symmetric recovery of entropy with composition rather than one-phase recovery.
assumption_audit.parent_reduction: The successor reduces to the parent when heterogeneity_weight = 0.

response_change.parent_relation: At fixed confinement_strength, the denominator decreases smoothly with mixedness x(1-x) through a single accessibility channel, so entropy recovery from confined suppression is governed by one symmetric composition scale and one sharpened cooperative correction.
response_change.child_relation: Replace the single accessibility-recovery phase with a heterogeneous two-regime accessibility response in composition space, where confinement relief remains weak over moderately mixed compositions but rises more abruptly very near equimolar composition because only nearly balanced local environments unlock the most restricted configurations.
response_change.observable_effect: For the same confinement_strength, the entropy peak stays at x=1/2 but the approach to that peak becomes flatter at intermediate x and sharper close to x=1/2 than the parent can achieve with one shared parameter set.

evolution_plan.gap_statement: The parent assumes a single homogeneous composition-dependent accessibility-recovery phase under confinement, but real restricted environments can contain a more strongly blocked subset of local configurations that becomes accessible only in more nearly equimolar neighborhoods.
evolution_plan.baseline_assumption: The process already present—composition-assisted recovery of accessible local arrangements under confinement—is represented by one uniform smooth composition dependence for all restricted microconfigurations.
evolution_plan.scientific_mechanism: Heterogeneous confinement relief: different subsets of local configurational states require different degrees of local species balance, producing a two-stage symmetric recovery of entropy with composition rather than one-phase recovery.
evolution_plan.rationale: Vary composition x at fixed confinement_strength, with accessibility_scale and cooperative_accessibility fixed. In the parent, the entropy suppression relaxes through one symmetric accessibility function of x(1-x), so after refitting one shared parameter set the curve shape across intermediate and near-equimolar compositions is still constrained to a single-phase recovery. A scientifically admissible refinement is to relax that homogeneity assumption without introducing energetics or breaking species-exchange symmetry: some restricted local arrangements remain inaccessible until the neighborhood is more nearly balanced than the rest. Then the target mapping itself changes, not just auxiliary interpretation: s_mix(x) under confinement has weaker recovery at intermediate x but stronger curvature and a sharper rise near x=1/2, while keeping nonnegativity and the same peak location. This effect is observable when confinement is strong enough that the denominator materially suppresses entropy yet not so extreme that all mixed compositions look equally blocked. A single parent parameter set cannot reproduce both the flatter shoulders and the sharper central recovery across those conditions because it has only one recovery phase tied to one mixedness channel.

selected_embedding_pattern.description: Make the coefficient of an existing process depend on a declared quantity.

scenario_text: Consider an ideal binary mixture distributed randomly over equivalent microscopic sites at thermal equilibrium. The sampled composition determines the configurational entropy per site through the multiplicity of distinguishable arrangements. The target is the dimensionless mixing entropy after removing composition-independent contributions. Energetic interactions and spatial correlations are held fixed at zero in the baseline model.
